title: Ordered center-preserving Cech datum of a log blowup tower
statement: Let $u:(U,N)\to(X,M)$ be a log morphism of locally Noetherian fs log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], and $S$ a finite saturated log blowup tower over $U$ with its ordered actual centers $J_i$ [def-trf-strict-etale-log-blowup-procedure]. Write $s_i:U_i\to U$ for its recursive composite [def-per-strict-log-blowup-procedure], using the canonical log-map composition [def-per-log-morphism-composition]. In the bounded universes [def-weil-size-convention], define $P_i(T,a)=\{s:T\to U_i\mid s_i s=a\}$ for each locally Noetherian fs log scheme $T$ and log morphism $a:T\to U$. An ordered center-preserving Cech datum consists of bijections $\theta_{a,b,i}:P_i(T,a)\simeq P_i(T,b)$ for all $T,a,b$ with $ua=ub$, natural in log morphisms $T'\to T$. They satisfy $\theta_{a,a,i}=1$ and $\theta_{b,c,i}\theta_{a,b,i}=\theta_{a,c,i}$, commute with every ordered tower arrow, and preserve the actual centers: for every $s\in P_i(T,a)$, $s^*J_i=(\theta_{a,b,i}s)^*J_i$ as log ideal subsheaves on $T$. For a strict etale cover $u$, this is the functor-of-points presentation of an ordered center-preserving isomorphism of the two uncontracted recursive pullback towers on $U\times_XU$, equal to the identity on the diagonal and satisfying the triple-overlap cocycle. No stage is contracted.
